DJIA Market Happenings For Tuesday, November 20, 2018 Posted by admin on November 20th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Coca Cola (KO), Johnson & Johnson (JNJ), McDonald’s (MCD), Merck (MRK) and Verizon (VZ). Dow stock 52 week lows include Goldman Sachs (GS).
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -303 points.
Monday the Dow was down -395.78 (-1.56%) at 25,017.44.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +1.21%.
There were 9 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by Pfizer (PFE) +1.54%, Travelers (TRV) +1.36% and Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) +1.19%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by Boeing (BA) -4.47%, Apple (AAPL) -3.96% and Visa (V) -3.87%.
Apple (AAPL -3.96%) is down more than 1% in premarket trading after multiple suppliers indicated its cutting parts orders for the latest iPhones.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down 1.2 cents at $2.612 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
There are no Dow stocks set to report earnings in the near term.
